items.claim: Gubra announced that its partner AbbVie had presented detailed Phase 1 data for ABBV-295, a long-acting amylin analog, at EASD 2026, the release stating a half-life of 10.7 to 12.3 days, weight reductions of 7.8-9.8% over 12-13 weeks (9.7% on every-other-week dosing, 7.9% monthly), no serious adverse events and 92% of gastrointestinal side effects mild, in 60 participants.
items.source: Gubra A/S press release relaying AbbVie's EASD 2026 presentation

items.claim: Markus Rohrwild said the detailed EASD data "further highlight the differentiated profile of ABBV-295, including meaningful weight loss, favorable safety and tolerability, and a pharmacokinetic profile supporting the evaluation of dosing intervals beyond weekly administration", and said Gubra is pleased to see the programme advancing under AbbVie's leadership.

The same announcement, redistributed on TradingView via the Modular Finance feed, repeated the CEO quote and stated that a Phase 2 trial of ABBV-295 in adults with overweight and obesity was initiated in August 2026.
items.source: Gubra A/S press release as redistributed by TradingView / Modular Finance, quoting CEO Markus Rohrwild
